Privacy Policy

Last updated: 15 May 2026

01

Overview

Reign ("the app", "we") is a fitness tracking application that uses your device camera to count exercise repetitions and analyse movement form in real time.

This policy explains what data we collect, why we collect it, and how it is stored and protected. We believe in keeping this simple and honest.

02

Data We Collect

Data Purpose Stored where
Email address Account creation and sign-in (OTP) Supabase Auth (cloud)
Display name, city / district, state Leaderboard territory grouping Supabase database (cloud)
Workout sessions
exercise type, rep count, duration, date		 Personal records and leaderboard scoring Supabase database (cloud)
Form score (0–100) Post-session AI coaching feedback Supabase database (cloud)
AI coach chat messages Conversation history within the app Supabase database (cloud)
Streak and achievement data In-app progress tracking Device + Supabase
Camera frames during workout Real-time pose detection only Never recorded or stored
Processed on-device only. Never transmitted.
03

Camera Permission

The camera is used exclusively to detect body pose landmarks during an active workout session using Google ML Kit, which runs entirely on your device.

No video, images, or camera frames are ever transmitted to any server or stored anywhere. We cannot access your camera outside of an active workout session. The camera is only activated when you explicitly start a workout.
04

Data We Do Not Collect

  • Precise GPS location
  • Health data beyond self-reported workout reps and duration
  • Payment information (no in-app purchases at this time)
  • Your data is ever sold to any third party
  • Your data is used for advertising purposes
05

Third-Party Services

Reign uses the following third-party services. Each is limited strictly to its stated purpose.

Supabase

Cloud database and authentication. Your account and workout data is stored in Supabase's managed PostgreSQL infrastructure, protected by Row-Level Security.

supabase.com/privacy ↗
Google ML Kit

On-device pose detection for exercise form analysis and rep counting. No data leaves your device via this library. All processing is entirely local.

Google Gemini API

Powers the Reign Commander AI coach. Your messages to the Commander are sent to Gemini via a secure, server-side proxy. Your workout context is used solely to generate coaching responses.

policies.google.com/privacy ↗
06

Data Retention

Your account data is retained as long as your account is active. Workout sessions and chat history are retained indefinitely to power your personal records and coaching context — this history is what makes your AI coach improve over time.

Chat messages with the AI coach are retained to provide coaching context. You may request deletion of your chat history independently without deleting your full account.

You may request deletion of all your data at any time by contacting us. We will action all deletion requests within 30 days.

07

Data Security

We have implemented the following technical measures to protect your data:

🔒 HTTPS / TLS encryption in transit
🗄️ Supabase encrypted infrastructure at rest
🛡️ Row-Level Security — your data, your access only
📵 Camera frames never leave your device
08

Children's Privacy

Reign is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect data from children under 13. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us and we will delete it promptly.

09

You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data at any time. Contact us at the email below and we will respond within 30 days.
